evidence: Strong cytotoxic NK program: NKG7 100%, GNLY 94%, GZMB 98%, FCGR3A 86%; CD3D 11% and CD8A 9% disfavor a T-cell majority.
B-cell program: CD79A 94%, MS4A1 86%, TCL1A 63%, FCER2 enriched; CD27 detected only 11%. Naive-like denotes expression phenotype, not functional verification.
PPBP and PF4 in 100%, GP9 92%, ITGA2B 85%; small n=13 and lower counts are consistent with platelet profiles. Residual leukocyte signal may reflect ambient RNA/aggregates.
XCL1/XCL2 each 91%, KLRC1 64%, NKG7 100%, GNLY 77% favor an NK-like population; CD3E 59%, CD3D 36%, IL7R 55% conflict with a pure NK assignment. n=22; T/NK mixtures or doublets cannot be excluded.

CD3D 88%, CD3E 79%, GZMK 93%, CCL5 96%, NKG7 97% identify a GZMK+ T-cell population. CD8A 49%, CD8B 20% and SLC4A10 expression in a minority: CD8/MAIT-like subsets possible but not assigned to the entire cluster.

FCER1A 88%, CLEC10A 74%, CD1C 53%, HLA-DRA/CD74 100% favor CD1C+ conventional DC; LYZ 97%, LST1 91%, FCN1 68% are overlapping myeloid signals, CLEC4C occurs in 15%. n=34; mixed myeloid/dendritic states or doublets cannot be excluded.
CD3D 87%, CD3E 77%, IL7R 66%, LTB 92% support T cells with a less cytotoxic IL7R+ phenotype; CCR7 36%, TCF7 37%, low GZMB 3%. CD4 only 10%, CD8B 17%: CD4/naive subtype is not assigned to all cells.
CD3D 91%, CD8A 54%, CD8B 49%, NKG7 99%, CCL5 100%, GZMH 70% support cytotoxic CD8 T cells; some NK-associated transcripts overlap, but CD3D is prevalent.
CD14 67%, FCN1 95%, S100A8 97%, S100A9 100%, LYZ 100%, LST1 96% support classical-like CD14+ monocytes; FCGR3A is low (13%).
FCGR3A 98%, MS4A7 80%, LST1 100%, LYZ 99%, CDKN1C 51%, HES4 61%; CD14 only 15%. Supports CD16+ / non-classical-like monocytes rather than NK cells, but a precise monocyte state is not established.
